beats.label: Enter · defining edge
beats.direction: Lower-magnification approved artwork; focus follows its flat source plane. No early depth echoes.

beats.label: Separate · from Athar
beats.direction: Four masked components peel into distinct Z planes; two contour families emerge from their edges.

beats.label: Passage · negative space
beats.direction: Open contours frame a clear passage. Nine supporting planes per family use three luminosity tiers.

beats.label: Accelerate · luminous crest
beats.direction: Explicit forward-travel key and two restrained leading halos create the peak. Preview velocity before approval.

beats.label: Gather · visible convergence
beats.direction: Supporting planes shorten and disappear while leaders and source fragments gather toward the final silhouette.

beats.label: Land · intact mark
beats.direction: Fragments register, intact mark reaches full strength, tonal transient lands and the lower-stroke wave begins.

beats.label: Hold · leave a trace
beats.direction: All visible animation has ended. Original mark and optically shifted original wordmark remain still until 7.0s.

name: ATHAR — Enter the Trace · Studio study
summary: Studio study refined with Astra from five native review frames. Approved mark and wordmark, contour traces, separated logo fragments, real camera travel, a registered landing, an imprint wave and a still final hold. Includes editable depth and lockup subcompositions and a timed synthesized score. Review the rendered film and audio before delivery.
